text:
Jess (Support): escalating Brightwell Health onboarding — multiple blockers flagged by support during setup. Customer says data sync fails and SSO keeps throwing 401. They explicitly said this jeopardizes their renewal timeline. Need CS to take the lead on comms and prioritization. Support ticket: #12345.

Ana (CS): on it. I'll take ownership of comms. Can someone paste the last 24h error logs and confirm whether this is a config issue or a runtime failure? Also want the customer's preferred meeting window.

Ted (Eng Oncall): I can join the deep-dive. grabbing logs now. quick excerpt: ```
[2026-03-20T23:18:04Z] ERROR upstream 502 /sync - timeout
[2026-03-21T02:04:11Z] ERROR auth 401 token_revoked for user org/brightwell
[2026-03-21T03:11:00Z] INFO retrying ingestion batch 7/10
```

Jess (Support): Thanks Ted. Customer reported 5 failed sync attempts since last night. SSO failure occurred after a metadata change on their IdP (they rolled a cert). They tried re-authorizing but still get 401. Customer quote: "If we can't go live before our renewal review, we'll pause."

Omar (CS Manager): Marking priority=P1 (renewal at risk). Proposed comms playbook: 1) Immediate acknowledgement email within 1 hour from assigned CSM, 2) Schedule 60min technical session within 24h (CS + Eng + Customer), 3) Daily standup until root cause resolved, 4) Exec escalation note to account sponsor if not resolved in 48h. Draft outreach below — please refine before sending.

Ana (CS): draft outreach (short):
"Hi Taylor — thanks for flagging and I'm sorry for the disruption. We're treating this as high priority. We've scheduled a technical troubleshooting call for tomorrow at 10:00 PT (please confirm) and our engineering on-call will join. Immediate next steps: 1) we will confirm whether this is an IdP cert/config drift vs runtime token issue, 2) run a controlled re-auth flow, 3) keep you updated at EOD. I (Ana) am your point of contact: ana@redwood.ai.
We will follow up within 1 hour with meeting invite + troubleshooting checklist."

Ted (Eng Oncall): for the deep-dive agenda I'd propose: 1) quick customer impact summary (5m), 2) reproduce auth flow with support-provided trace (15m), 3) IdP metadata check and temporary mitigation (20m), 4) plan for permanent fix or config rollback (15m), 5) confirm rollback/patch owner and ETA (5m).

Jess (Support): customer preferred morning PT. I've shared the SAML metadata and a redacted trace in the ticket. Also attached: screenshots of the 401 from their console.

Omar (CS Manager): assigning owners and SLAs: Ana = CSM owner for comms and customer-facing updates (SLA: 1 hour ack), Ted = Eng owner for triage (SLA: initial triage 4 hours), Jess = Support owner for ticket coordination and artifacts. If unresolved by 48h escalate to me for exec note. Please add daily standup calendar invite.

Ana (CS): I'll send the acknowledgement now and book the technical session for 10:00 PT tomorrow. Sending draft to @Omar and @Ted for quick sign-off. :thumbsup:

OnboardBot: Incident INC-1976 created for Brightwell Health — severity: P1, owners: Ana (CS), Ted (Eng Oncall), Jess (Support).

Ted (Eng Oncall): noted — will post a first triage update in the ticket within 3 hours. 

Ana (CS): action items recap: 
- Ana: send ack email & calendar invite (now)
- Ted: reproduce and post triage log + temporary mitigation (within 4h)
- Jess: collect IdP cert + traces and confirm last successful sync timestamp (now)
- Omar: prepare exec update template if unresolved in 48h

Ana (CS): sending outreach. I'll paste the sent copy here after it's out.

Jess (Support): thanks team. keeping this thread as the single source for comms so we can forward the timeline to the customer if needed.

Ana (CS): sent — pasted message to customer and calendar invite scheduled. copying the snippet we sent: "We're on it — technical session scheduled for tomorrow 10:00 PT. Our eng on-call will attend. Immediate next step: run re-auth flow together in the call to validate IdP cert rotation."

Omar (CS Manager): good. please also capture a short postmortem and impact summary once resolved so we can include mitigations in the renewal discussion.

OnboardBot: Reminder set — check-in in 24h for status update.
